scope: Focused replacement imagery for two Canadian Heraldic Authority register pages whose apparent arms images are certificates showing no municipal artwork. These files are true municipal achievements and close the City of Richmond and City of North Vancouver gaps. No new vector source found in this focused pass.

assets.title: City of Richmond — official full achievement
assets.timeline_note: The 1996 Canadian registration records the original College of Arms grant of 16 August 1979. The website does not establish the date of this drawing; it is not a separately dated design.
assets.derivation: Original official website JPEG downloaded without alteration. Visually verified full achievement with salmon shield, female supporters, heron crest and CHILD OF THE FRASER motto.
assets.author: Artist not identified by source
assets.license: No open licence established. The official page states that reproduction or use requires written permission from the City of Richmond.

assets.title: City of North Vancouver — full achievement in 1998 Social Plan
assets.source_type: Official City of North Vancouver publication
assets.timeline_note: The 2006 Canadian registration records the original College of Arms grant of 2 April 1982. The Social Plan was adopted on 14 September 1998; this is a reproduction of those arms, not evidence of a new 1998 design. This holder is the City, not the District, of North Vancouver.
assets.derivation: Source PDF cover image XRef 248 is a 360×546 one-bit CCITT image mask. Rendered its image rectangle through the PDF to apply the stencil correctly, using uniform scale 360/165.60000610351562 (2.173913...) and preserving the published document aspect ratio. Output is 361×471 due to pixel-boundary rounding. No tracing, recolouring, artificial enlargement or heraldic redrawing. Includes the surrounding municipal name as printed.
assets.author: Artist not identified in publication
assets.license: No open licence established; official municipal publication retained as documentary source.
